name: carved-block
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE INDIVIDUAL MODULAR architectural stone piece for a premium stylized tropical ruin game. Broad sculpted bevels, clear three-dimensional form and restrained hand-painted texture. Muted warm limestone/sage-grey, cool dark desaturated teal stone recesses, pale cream rubbed bevels. Tiny occasional moss at seams only. No metallic gold, no micro-scratch noise. Neutral diffuse studio lighting, orthographic three-quarter view, whole object isolated on pale grey with generous empty margin. No floor, no scenery, no full building, no letters or watermark. One thick rectangular carved accent masonry block, 2m wide x 1.5m tall x 1m deep. The front has ONE bold original geometric spiral-sun relief carved into a recessed square field, broad raised central spiral and four large angular radiating shapes; no tiny glyphs or fine lines. A wide plain border and a thick visible plain side keep it reading as a structural stone rather than a decorative plaque. Depth between the relief and background is substantial and physically sculpted. Top and bottom seating faces are perfectly flat. Used occasionally over doorways among plain blocks.
